title: Logistics Secretary
description: Official Veolia Water Technologies role in Riyadh focused on logistics administration and shipment coordination support. The role covers data entry into logistics, ERP, and TMS systems, preparing and distributing shipping and inventory documents, coordinating meetings and communications with carriers and internal teams, maintaining logistics files and records, supporting KPI and compliance reporting, updating shipment statuses with freight forwarders and warehouse teams, and helping keep vendor and customer records current. The listing asks for a diploma or bachelor's in finance, logistics, or supply chain and notes 0-1 years of experience.
